items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And he talked so nice, he pleaded with me. And I didn't know, so I said no. But news travels around. So I went in with him.

ctx.x: because I had made money and had a little bank account. And I was more or less secure and felt more secure, and I didn't mind working.

Now, in between, -- oh, yeah, Chick wanted me, and so I felt sorry for Chick, he was handicapped. He's a good little drummer, but he was handicapped. And he was trying to get a band together. And he talked so nice, he pleaded with me. And I didn't know, so I said no. But news travels around. So I went in with him. And you know who was in the band? Johnny Hodges.
